definition: No position, no strategy entries, no strategy-driven fees, and no strategy-driven drawdown.
promotion_impact: If not beaten, candidate fails and no-trade remains default.
notes: Equal to no-trade is not a pass; blocking all trades is not an edge.

definition: Passive BTC buy-and-hold or normalized BTC exposure over the same evaluation window.
when_used: Every BTC-relevant or broad crypto active-strategy validation.
promotion_impact: If passive BTC dominates by a large margin, active strategy cannot be promoted unless a lower-risk role was predeclared and proven.
notes: Comparison must include absolute gap and interpretation.

definition: Simple buy-and-hold per market where feasible over the same window.
when_used: Basket, cross-market, and per-market strategy validations.
promotion_impact: If buy-and-hold dominates with lower complexity, active strategy is caution or fail.
notes: Must not be used for post-result market removal.

definition: Combined gate requiring positive after-fee expectancy, PF, breadth, concentration control, risk control, data quality, and complexity-adjusted justification.
when_used: Every candidate decision after base metrics are computed.
promotion_impact: Only candidates clearing this hurdle may become promising for confirmation.
notes: Stricter than positive PnL or no-trade comparison alone.
